plugin.name: Resident Evil HD Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip the logos at start-up and the save notice that only needs OK, and go straight to the title. The opening movie stays.
HideMouseCursorAfterMs.description: Hide the mouse cursor after this many milliseconds of inactivity. 0 never hides it; Always hides it while the game is focused.
DoorSkip.description: Skip the door, stairs and lift animations between rooms.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window with an exact client size, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Changes apply while playing. Alt+Enter returns to the last window mode; unsupported fullscreen sizes use the desktop mode.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show health and ammunition on supported Logitech keyboards. Requires Logitech G HUB.
DisableNoise.description: Turn off the film grain of the game's noise filter.
DisableColorCorrection.description: Turn off the game's color correction.
DisableFog.description: Disables fog in supported rendering passes. Restart required.
FPSLimit.description: Maximum rendered frame rate. Choose Variable in the game's Frame Rate option to exceed its fixed 30/60 modes. 0 is Unlimited; Monitor follows the display refresh rate. High rates may affect gameplay.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause game updates while another window has focus. Turn this off to keep the game running in the background. Native audio and input focus behavior stays unchanged.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of Plugins and the settings descriptions. Auto uses English when the game language cannot be detected. Edit this in the hub or CFG, then reopen Plugins.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: the defaults plus door skipping.
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
menu.pluginshelp: Settings for this fix and other installed plugins.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the pointer inside the active game window. Release it when unfocused or while the developer overlay is open.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Native controller button pictures: Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo. Auto uses Xbox. Keyboard and mouse names stay unchanged.
SkipPressStart.description: Continue through the first Press Any Key screen automatically. Loading and save confirmations keep their normal behavior.
